caption: The drawing is divided horizontally into two main sections. The upper section has a black background and features a repeating floral pattern: there are three large stylized flowers (two are yellow with a white center and one is blue and purple with a yellow center), each with green stems and leaves, spaced evenly across the top half. Between the larger flowers are smaller flowers, one purple and two yellow, also with green leaves. Near the top edge, there is a horizontal row of purple chevron shapes. Below the flowers, a white wavy line runs horizontally, with blue dots placed at regular intervals beneath it. The bottom section is filled with a solid reddish-brown color, and in the lower left corner, there is a small green leafy sprig with a light blue flower composed of five petals and a yellow center. The sections are separated by a thin red horizontal line. The composition is enclosed within a thin, light-colored border.
title: Stencilled Floor
